主要内容: On January 11, 2019, Taxi Medallion Loan Trust III, an indirect unconsolidated subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into an amendment to its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment extended the maturity date of the credit facility to September 15, 2019 and amended certain financial covenants. The restructuring of the facility, completed on November 8, 2018, resulted in the deconsolidation of the Trust in the Company's financial results effective November 8, 2018. The amendment is attached as Exhibit 10.1 and incorporated by reference into the filing. This amendment reflects changes to the financial terms of the credit facility and may impact the financial reporting of Medallion Financial Corp. and the broader financial services industry.
